name: web-console-readiness
title: Web-Console Release Readiness
description:
Drive web-console to paid-release readiness as the business bundle's co-headliner alongside Git Control Tower.

Dependency: gated on continuous-audio-platform completing — audio provider routing, reliability fixes (VAD false-silence, TTS summarization bug), test hardening, and audio-tools adoption must land and validate before monetization hardening starts. Starting hardening work before the audio layer stabilizes risks burning effort on behavior that still has known reliability issues.

Known gaps to workshop (not yet items — workshop phase will shape these):
- production-readiness audit (GATE item — classifies branch as 'needs progress work first' vs 'ready for monetization hardening')
- pricing/billing integration (required for paid release)
- LPBS registration + subscription-tier feature-allocation config (audio feature quotas per tier)
- auth/security review
- in-UI documentation surface
- convergence: spec-sync run, documentation-health run (always, at the end)

Items to pull in from elsewhere: `execute/web-console-tts-code-tick-handling` (currently standalone).

Items to NOT pull in: anything under continuous-audio-platform stays there. Removing them would weaken a coherent initiative for the sake of tracking optics. The depends_on relationship is how this initiative tracks its dependency on the audio work without cannibalizing it.
